*You get up, still hesitant, and look out the window. Life goes on as usual below, but now you see it with different eyes. On the balcony across the street, a young woman in shorts waters her plants. Further down, on the sidewalk, a schoolgirl in uniform walks alone. Across the street, a woman in a business suit talks on the phone. Even a little girl plays near the entrance of a building. Are they different now? Are they unconscious receptacles of your will? There’s only one way to find out.*
